title: Introduction to Quarters Using Circular Cut-outs

studentJourney.title: Welcome to Quarters
studentJourney.content: Amina has one round chapati. She wants to share it fairly with her 3 friends. That makes 4 people altogether!
studentJourney.owlText: Imagine you have one round chapati to share fairly among 4 people. How can you make sure everyone gets the same amount?
studentJourney.storyIntro: Today, you will learn how to split one whole into 4 equal parts. Each part is called one quarter.

studentJourney.title: Your Mission
studentJourney.content: Help Amina share one whole chapati equally among 4 people.
studentJourney.owlText: Your mission: find a fair way to share among 4, and learn the special name for each piece!

visualSpec.title: Your mission has 4 parts:
visualSpec.missionIntro: Amina needs to share one chapati among 4 people. Help her find the fair way.
items: Check that all 4 pieces are the same size.
Learn that one equal part is called one quarter.

feedbackSpec.correct: Mission accepted! Let's discover quarters together.

studentJourney.title: Think First
studentJourney.content: Before we learn the rule, look carefully. Which picture shows a fair way to share one chapati among 4 people?
studentJourney.owlText: Look carefully. Fair sharing means everyone gets the same size piece. Which picture shows 4 equal parts?

visualSpec.prompt: Which picture shows a fair way to share one chapati among 4 people?
visualSpec.instruction: Choose the picture where all 4 pieces are the same size.

choices.label: A
choices.title: Unequal pieces
choices.feedback: Not quite. The pieces are different sizes, so the sharing is not fair.

choices.label: B
choices.title: 2 equal pieces
choices.feedback: Not quite. Two equal parts make one half. We need 4 equal parts for 4 people.

choices.label: C
choices.title: 4 equal pieces
choices.description: 4 equal parts — one for each person
choices.feedback: Yes! Four equal parts means each person gets exactly the same amount. That is fair sharing!

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! Four equal parts — one for each person. That is fair!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Look carefully. We need 4 equal parts for 4 people.

studentJourney.title: What Is One Quarter?
studentJourney.content: When we split one whole into 4 equal parts, each part is called one quarter. We write one quarter as 1/4.
studentJourney.owlText: Let's see how one whole chapati becomes one quarter, step by step.

visualSpec.intro: Follow these steps to see how one whole becomes one quarter.

steps.title: Split into 4
steps.description: Cut it into 4 equal parts. The dotted line shows where to cut.

steps.title: One quarter
steps.description: One of the 4 equal parts is called one quarter.

steps.title: Write it as 1/4
steps.description: We write: one quarter equals 1/4. The 4 means 4 equal parts. The 1 means 1 part.

studentJourney.title: Find the Quarter
studentJourney.content: Which picture correctly shows 1/4? Look carefully at how many equal parts each shape has.
studentJourney.owlText: Time to test your eyes! Only one picture shows a true quarter.

visualSpec.instruction: Choose the picture where one quarter is shaded.

choices.label: A
choices.feedback: Not quite. This shows 1 out of 2 equal parts. That is one half, not one quarter.

choices.label: B
choices.feedback: Not quite. This shows 1 out of 3 equal parts. That is one third. We need 4 equal parts.

choices.label: C
choices.feedback: Yes! 1/4 means 1 out of 4 equal parts. You found the quarter!

choices.label: D
choices.feedback: Not quite. This shows 1 out of 5 equal parts. A quarter needs exactly 4 equal parts.

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! 1/4 means 1 out of 4 equal parts. Well done!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Not quite. Remember: a quarter needs exactly 4 equal parts.

studentJourney.title: Worked Example: Make a Quarter
studentJourney.content: Let's make one quarter using circular paper. Follow each step.
studentJourney.owlText: I will show you how to fold paper into 4 equal parts!

visualSpec.intro: Follow these steps to make one quarter from circular paper.

steps.title: Get a circle
steps.description: Start with a round piece of paper or a paper plate.

steps.title: Fold in half
steps.description: Fold the circle so the edges meet perfectly.

steps.title: Fold in half again
steps.description: Fold it in half one more time. Now you have 4 layers.

steps.title: Open and shade one quarter
steps.description: Open it up. You see 4 equal parts. Shade one part to show 1/4.

studentJourney.title: Your Turn
studentJourney.content: Look at these shapes. Which one shows one quarter? Tap the correct one.
studentJourney.owlText: Time to practice! Show me you can spot a quarter.

visualSpec.instruction: Choose the shape where exactly one quarter is shaded.

choices.label: A
choices.feedback: Not quite. Half of the shape is shaded. We need only 1 out of 4 parts.

choices.label: B
choices.feedback: Yes! You found one quarter — 1 out of 4 equal parts.

choices.label: C
choices.title: 1 whole
choices.feedback: Not quite. The whole shape is shaded. A quarter is only 1 out of 4 parts.

feedbackSpec.incorrect: Try again. Look for 4 equal parts with only 1 shaded.

studentJourney.title: Quick Check
studentJourney.content: One more question! Which picture correctly shows 1/4?
studentJourney.owlText: Let me check if you truly understand quarters!

visualSpec.instruction: Pick the one that is truly one quarter.

choices.label: A
choices.feedback: Yes! 1 out of 4 equal parts is one quarter. Well done!

choices.label: B
choices.feedback: Not quite. This is one half. A quarter needs 4 equal parts.

choices.label: C
choices.feedback: Not quite. This is one third. A quarter needs 4 equal parts.

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! You understand one quarter perfectly!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Not quite. Remember: 1/4 needs exactly 4 EQUAL parts.

studentJourney.title: Think About It
studentJourney.content: You did great! Now think about what you learned.
studentJourney.owlText: How do you know when a piece is one quarter?

studentJourney.title: Lesson Complete
studentJourney.content: You learned that one quarter is one part out of four equal parts, written as 1/4. You can now share food fairly among 4 people!
studentJourney.owlText: Fantastic work today! You are now a quarter expert!
